tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in both modes. Light is a lavender-tinted white; dark is the night sky the àlọ́ is told under.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the reading panel, speech bubbles and sheets on `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only. Too faint for control borders: use `line-strong` there.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (secondary buttons, inputs) and resting lanterns. At least 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and every `-soft` tint, in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The brand colour: adire indigo. Primary actions, the mic button, links and selected states. As text, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `night-soft`.

tokens.name: night-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind `night` or `ink` text: selected cards, the 'needs support in both' pill.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `night` fill. Dark in the dark theme, because `night` lightens there.

tokens.name: night-edge
tokens.usage: The 3D bottom edge under `night` buttons. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: moon
tokens.usage: Rewards and only rewards: stars, lit lanterns, earned badges, the 'continue' button after a story. Never for warnings.

tokens.name: moon-soft
tokens.usage: Badge medallions and reward backgrounds behind `ink` text.

tokens.name: moon-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge under `moon` buttons. Fill only.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Energy and the call: the 'Àlọ́ o!' moment, secondary game actions, 'try again' (never red in kid mode). Text on it is `on-bright`.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the call bubble and gentle 'let's try again' states, behind `ink` or `coral-text`.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral as text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `coral-soft` (5:1 or better).

tokens.name: coral-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge under `coral` buttons. Fill only.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Success and 'done': finished steps, checks, the 'on track' pill. Text on it is `on-bright`.

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind `leaf-text` or `ink` for success messages.

tokens.name: leaf-text
tokens.usage: Leaf as text on `surface` and `leaf-soft`.

tokens.name: leaf-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge under `leaf` buttons. Fill only.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Listening and information: the mic while it listens, sound waves, hints. Text on it is `on-bright`.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind `sky-text` or `ink`; the listening glow.

tokens.name: sky-text
tokens.usage: Sky as text on `surface` and `sky-soft`.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `moon`, `coral`, `leaf` and `sky` fills, in both themes (5:1 or better). Never white on those fills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3px ring, 3px offset. At least 5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Grown-up mode only: system errors (payment failed, connection lost). Never shown to children.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in grown-up screens: an alias of `night`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Celebration screens and the session opener. One per screen.

styles.name: display-m
styles.sample: The Goat on the Football Field

styles.name: kid-title
styles.usage: Prompts and section titles children see.

styles.name: kid-body
styles.usage: Speech bubbles and any text a child might read.

styles.name: reading-p1
styles.sample: Ada had a small brown goat.

styles.name: reading-p3
styles.sample: Tunde loved football more than anything.

styles.name: reading-p5
styles.sample: The market was busier than ever that Saturday.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and page titles for parents and teachers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: He remembered parts of the story.
styles.usage: Running text in reports, the teacher view and settings.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above values. Grown-up mode only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding in grown-up mode; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding in kid mode; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Reading-panel padding; gaps between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above celebration titles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom breathing room on kid screens.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Small chips and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Grown-up buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Kid buttons, speech bubbles, the reading panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, celebration cards, the app icon.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, the mic button and medallions.

shadow.note: Alo.ai uses solid offset 'press' edges, not blurred shadows: a button sits on its own darker edge and drops onto it when tapped.

tokens.name: press-night
tokens.usage: Under `night` buttons and the mic button.

tokens.name: press-moon
tokens.usage: Under `moon` buttons.

tokens.name: press-coral
tokens.usage: Under `coral` buttons.

tokens.name: press-leaf
tokens.usage: Under `leaf` buttons.

tokens.name: press-neutral
tokens.usage: Under secondary buttons.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Under cards and the reading panel.

tokens.name: tap-kid
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything a child taps.

tokens.name: tap-grown
tokens.usage: Minimum height of controls for parents and teachers.

tokens.name: mic
tokens.usage: Diameter of the mic button.

tokens.name: measure-reading
tokens.usage: Maximum width of story text (about 45 characters a line at reading sizes).

tokens.name: mascot-m
tokens.usage: Default width of Jàpá on kid screens.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Width at and below which layouts switch to the tablet/phone arrangement. CSS cannot read a custom property inside @media, so write 900px there and cite this token in a comment.
